summary: Practise pest scouting, action thresholds and IPM planning with field scenarios. Explore the course outline and learning outcomes.
lede: Integrated pest management training helps crop-protection professionals assess pest pressure and choose proportionate field responses. For advisers, agronomists and field supervisors, it builds practical skills in scouting, applying action thresholds and comparing cultural, biological, mechanical and chemical controls. Participants also practise intervention records and follow-up monitoring, with pesticide stewardship and resistance concerns informing decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who assess pest pressure, advise on crop protection or coordinate pest-control work and need a consistent method for field decisions.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with crop production, field scouting or pest-control activities is recommended.
